parameters.name: X-Worker-Timestamp
parameters.description: UTC Unix timestamp in seconds, ±300 second acceptance window.

parameters.name: X-Worker-Nonce
parameters.description: Unique nonce, retained for ten minutes.

post.description: Maximum raw body 1MiB. HMAC covers timestamp, nonce, method, pathname, sha256(rawBody), separated by newline. Verify current task lease token and approved source. Idempotency by (runId,batchId). Final batch is sent only after all preceding batches acknowledged.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-campus_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque HttpOnly session; user identity resolved server-side. CSRF and Origin validation required for mutations.

workerHmac.name: X-Worker-Signature
workerHmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex signature. See 05-api.md for canonical signing input, replay protection and lease checks.

sortKey.description: Decimal string; clients must not calculate positions.

orderingScope.description: stage orders against the entire target column. company orders against only the current card company sub-sequence. Other UI filters do not redefine ordering.

ApplicationMove.description: CLOSED requires non-null closedReason. Other stages reject non-null closedReason. Anchors must be adjacent and in target stage; both omitted appends.

Error.description: Structured error; requestId correlates with redacted server logs.
